name: bipartite_matching
author: 8f0a9ac4
description: Uses the Hopcroft-Karp algorithm to find a maximum-cardinality matching in a bipartite graph. It answers assignment questions such as the largest possible set of student-project pairs. The tool validates bipartiteness, treats directed edges as undirected for matching, and returns deterministic matched node references plus the matching size.

graph_id.description: ID of the bipartite graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of matched pairs to return.
